message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Block memoryDump:credentialAccess and jumpHost:lateralMovement. Blocking memoryDump disables dbLogin, ssoLogin, and apiToken, which also disables backupHost, appServer, domainAdmin, and secretsManager. Blocking jumpHost additionally disables serviceAccount. Consequently all four parents of the target are unreachable. At least two blocks are necessary: one independently reachable route uses containerHost, memoryDump, dbLogin, backupHost, and vaultRead; another uses dmzWeb, workstation, vpnSession, jumpHost, and codeRepo. These routes share no blockable steps, so a single block cannot stop both."}
